verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents cron, systemd timers or any other recurring scheduler. The closest item, 'Start an application at login', is a one-off login trigger rather than a recurring schedule, so it is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
